clauses.title: Scope of Services
clauses.text: Blue Ridge Industries shall provide the services described in Exhibit A (the "Services") to Fulcrum Logistics in a professional and workmanlike manner, consistent with industry standards. Any changes to the scope of the Services must be agreed in writing by both parties before work begins.

clauses.title: Compensation
clauses.text: In consideration of the Services, Fulcrum Logistics shall pay Blue Ridge Industries fees not to exceed $113,000 per invoice period. All invoices are payable within 15 days of receipt. Amounts unpaid after the due date accrue interest at the lesser of 1.5% per month or the maximum rate permitted by law.

clauses.title: Confidentiality
clauses.text: Each party agrees to hold in strict confidence all non-public information disclosed by the other party in connection with this Agreement, and to use such information solely to perform its obligations hereunder. This obligation survives termination of this Agreement for a period of 6 months.

clauses.title: Limitation of Liability
clauses.text: Except for breaches of confidentiality, neither party shall be liable for any indirect, incidental, special, or consequential damages arising out of this Agreement. Each party's aggregate liability shall not exceed the total fees paid or payable by Fulcrum Logistics in the twelve months preceding the claim.

clauses.title: Intellectual Property
clauses.text: All work product created by Blue Ridge Industries specifically for Fulcrum Logistics under this Agreement shall be the sole property of Fulcrum Logistics upon full payment of the applicable fees. Blue Ridge Industries retains ownership of its pre-existing materials, tools, and methodologies.

clauses.title: Governing Law
clauses.text: This Agreement shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of the State of New York, without regard to its conflict of laws principles. The parties consent to the exclusive jurisdiction of the state and federal courts located in New York.

clauses.title: Independent Contractor
clauses.text: Blue Ridge Industries is an independent contractor and nothing in this Agreement creates a partnership, joint venture, agency, or employment relationship between the parties. Blue Ridge Industries is solely responsible for its own taxes, insurance, and employee obligations.

clauses.title: Entire Agreement
clauses.text: This Agreement, together with its exhibits, constitutes the entire agreement between Fulcrum Logistics and Blue Ridge Industries with respect to its subject matter and supersedes all prior or contemporaneous understandings. Any amendment must be in writing and signed by both parties.
